name: hooks
description: Open source hooks library for AI coding agents. Storage is a data-backend switch, never a deployment mode: local SQLite at ~/.hasna/hooks/hooks.db by default, or PostgreSQL when HASNA_HOOKS_DATABASE_URL is set with HASNA_HOOKS_STORAGE_BACKEND=postgresql (src/db/storage-sync.ts). The retired HASNA_HOOKS_STORAGE_MODE / HOOKS_STORAGE_MODE deployment-mode variables are read as errors, not no-ops. The optional remote registry is a Cloudflare Workers API (D1 catalog + R2 artifacts, provisioned by `hooks cf deploy`) reached through the @hasna/contracts 1.0.2 client resolver (hasna/apps#1720): a strict URL+key pair resolved fresh per call (src/lib/transport.ts) from the Keychain items hasna.credentials.hooks.api-url / .api-key, ~/.hasna/hooks/config/credentials, then HASNA_HOOKS_API_URL / HASNA_HOOKS_API_KEY, with the fleet gateway https://api.hasna.com/hooks as the URL default. The app's own chain is gone: ~/.hasna/fleet-env, ~/.hasna/cloud, ~/.config/hasna, $XDG_CONFIG_HOME, ~/.hasna/hooks/config.json (api_url / api_key_ref), HASNA_HOOKS_REGISTRY_URL / HOOKS_REGISTRY_URL, and any *_MODE transport switch are never read. MCP is served by the `hooks mcp` subcommand (no separate mcp bin).

readiness.description: Implemented: GET /ready returns 200 {status: ready} when the hooks.lock store is readable, else 503 (src/serve.ts).

version.description: Implemented: GET /version returns the installed @hasna/hooks version (src/serve.ts).

pgTestGate.command: HASNA_HOOKS_DATABASE_URL="${HASNA_HOOKS_TEST_DATABASE_URL:?point it at a throwaway Postgres; the live-PG gate must not pass without one}" HASNA_HOOKS_STORAGE_BACKEND=postgresql bun test src/db/pg-live.test.ts
